observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A spacious community hall or recreation room with a polished wooden floor, a stage with draped curtains at the front, and seated spectators along the side.
observation.dancers: A mixed group of around 10 to 12 adult men and women.
observation.formation_and_space: A single curved line/semi-circle holding hands, moving dynamically across the wooden floor and occasionally curving into loops.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward lean during energetic steps, soft knees, and alternating weight distribution as they step and hop.
observation.footwork: Brisk stepping patterns including steps to the side, quick heel digs, stamps, hops, and occasional high knee lifts timed with the upbeat music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in a V-hold or belt hold (hands on neighbors' belts/waists), lifting one hand or waving with energy during solos or specific sequences.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso isolation, moving naturally with the bounding steps and jumps.
observation.partnering: Connected in a line by holding hands or belts; no closed couple partnering.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent small hops, energetic vertical jumps with high knee extensions, and turning formations as the line loops.
observation.costume_and_props: Matching black short-sleeved t-shirts and dark trousers or jeans with comfortable shoes.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork precision for rapid taps and exact weight transfers due to camera movement and wide-angle framing.

signature_moments.what: The line performs energetic high knee lifts and jumps while traveling to the side.
The line curves into a tight circle, dancing in a continuous rotating loop.
Dancers execute quick heel touches and sharp directional changes in a compact circle.
